verdict.rationale: Data export applies to a hosted sandbox platform, but Daytona documents no dedicated export or offboarding feature. Leaving is only indirectly possible: snapshots can be defined from standard images or Dockerfiles you keep yourself, and sandbox files are reachable over SSH and the SDKs/CLI, so you would have to extract data manually. Missing for 10: a documented bulk export of sandboxes, snapshots and volumes, an export of snapshot state in open formats (e.g. OCI images or tarballs), account-level export or offboarding guidance, and independent corroboration of migrating off Daytona.
